summary: Preinstall alternate-runtime dropper: downloads Bun and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package advertises itself as a Jest preset for React Native (main: jest-preset.js), but ships a preinstall lifecycle hook (scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs") whose behavior is unrelated to Jest configuration. setup.mjs is heavily obfuscated (obfuscator.io-style `_0x...` identifiers and string-lookup tables) and, on `npm install`, downloads the Bun runtime zip from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<VER>/<arch>.zip, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes the downloaded Bun binary against a sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB Bun-compiled bundle (header `// @bun @bun-cjs`) with a rotated string-array decoder and a ~1000-entry constants table; its behavior is opaque to Node-based tooling because it is executed outside the Node runtime. Neither the runtime fetch nor the payload execution relates to the package's declared purpose. The legitimate jest-preset.js code path never references setup.mjs or math_init.js. Using an alternate runtime to execute an obfuscated bundle at install time is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
